page.meta_description: Oceanography is the science of the world ocean: Challenger-era sounding and dredging, Cousteau's public diving, plate-tectonic seafloor, hydrothermal vents,…
page.content:
Currents, trenches, and vessels that chart the planet's connected seas.

How Oceanography connects

  • Event: Challenger expedition — The Challenger expedition founded oceanography as a global survey science.
  • Topic: Seafloor spreading — Seafloor spreading is the plate-tectonic core of modern geological oceanography.
  • Faction: Scripps Institution of Oceanography — Scripps is a leading Pacific campus for oceanographic research.
  • Faction: Woods Hole Oceanographic Institution — Woods Hole is a leading Atlantic laboratory for deep-sea work.
  • Character: Jacques Cousteau — Cousteau made ocean life a public subject beyond the research fleet.
  • Event: El Niño — El Niño is a Pacific ocean–atmosphere rhythm studied as climate oceanography.

What is Oceanography?

Oceanography is the science of the world ocean: Challenger-era sounding and dredging, Cousteau's public diving, plate-tectonic seafloor, hydrothermal vents, and the labs at Scripps and Woods Hole that still run the ships.

Key threads lead to Challenger expedition, Seafloor spreading, Scripps Institution of Oceanography, Woods Hole Oceanographic Institution, Jacques Cousteau and El Niño.
